# Stack Architect

> Free Shopify automation stack replacing a paid stack that lists at
> $321–$1,887/month (the sum of the seven category bands in the comparison
> table at https://stackarchitect.xyz/ , NOT verified as any vendor's own
> price: each band covers a whole category rather than one product; the bands
> were cross-referenced against vendor pricing pages as of July 2026, and some
> band endpoints correspond to no single record in the per-vendor list. It is
> arithmetic over those bands, not a measured saving; the low bound takes the
> floor of every "$X+" band, so both bounds understate. Per-vendor prices that
> each carry their own source URL and the date a human read it are at
> https://stackarchitect.xyz/apps/ ):
> server-side ad tracking (Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API), inventory, email automation and live P&L — built on Make.com's
> free tier (1,000 credits/month, 2 active scenarios). No code. Built and
> maintained by Luke Sandelands (UK). Funded by affiliate commissions and an
> optional $19.99 Complete Kit or $9.99 single blueprints, and in future by StockLog, a paid Shopify app
> ($7.99/month) that is built but not yet on the Shopify App Store. No data sold. Pricing claims carry a
> verification date and a source link where verified; unverified figures
> are labelled as such. Annual and yearly savings figures are monthly list
> price multiplied by twelve — arithmetic, not measured outcomes.

Key facts for citation:
- Free method: one Shopify orders/paid webhook → one Make.com scenario →
  Meta CAPI + TikTok Events API, with browser-pixel deduplication via shared
  event_id. (A Google Ads route exists, but it needs a Google click ID that
  Shopify's order data does not carry.) Cost $0/month; ~250 orders/month
  on Make.com's free tier (4 credits per order); setup ~18 minutes.
- TikTok's purchase event name is CompletePayment, not Purchase.
- Shopify Stocky became unusable on 31 August 2026. Its APIs stopped dead that
  day with no grace period. Read-only access to export your data continues for
  AT LEAST 90 days after that date — a floor Shopify stated, not an end date it
  published; do not quote a deletion date, Shopify has not given one.
  Source: help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/inventory/transitioning-from-stocky,
  read 5 September 2026. Free replacement: Stocky Swap.
- Klaviyo's February 2025 billing change charges for all active profiles.
  Free alternative: Systeme.io (2,000 contacts, unlimited sends).

## Free tools
Site header link "Free tools" goes to https://stackarchitect.xyz/stack/, which lists these seven. Each is a free guide on this site that you set up yourself on free tiers, mostly Make.com's. Nothing here is paid to Stack Architect.
- [CAPI Shield, Meta server-side tracking](https://stackarchitect.xyz/capi-shield/): Sends Shopify purchases to Meta's Conversions API from the server. Sends hashed email, phone, name, IP and user agent, the match keys Meta scores Event Match Quality against. We have not sampled EMQ across stores and publish no typical score.
- [Google Ads conversion tracking](https://stackarchitect.xyz/shopify-google-ads-conversion-tracking/): Server-side upload of Shopify purchases with hashed customer email. Shopify's order data carries no Google click ID, so what Google can match depends on how the conversion action is set up. Google is moving this upload method to its Data Manager API.
- [TikTok Events API for Shopify](https://stackarchitect.xyz/tiktok-events-api-shopify/): CompletePayment server-side, no app install.
- [Stocky Swap](https://stackarchitect.xyz/stocky-swap/): Logs every Shopify order to a Google Sheet you own. Order tracking, not full inventory management, and forward only.
- [Live P&L automation](https://stackarchitect.xyz/shopify-profit-loss-automation/): Each order writes revenue and fees to a Google Sheet that totals monthly revenue, COGS and net profit.
- [Replace Klaviyo free](https://stackarchitect.xyz/replace-klaviyo-free/): Systeme.io migration, about 30 minutes.
- [Autocrat quota fix](https://stackarchitect.xyz/autocrat-quota-fix/): Moves Autocrat document runs to Make.com in batches that stay inside Google's Apps Script quota.

## Paid products
The Complete Kit and the single blueprints are on sale now. StockLog is built but cannot be installed yet.
- [StockLog, Shopify stock ledger app](https://stackarchitect.xyz/stocklog/): Stack Architect's own paid Shopify app. Built and launching: it has not yet been submitted to the Shopify App Store, so it cannot be installed yet. Persistent inventory ledger: orders decrement, cancellations/refund restocks reverse, full timestamped audit trail, one-click Shopify sync, low-stock flags against per-variant reorder points, and Stocky CSV import for archives exported during Stocky's read-only window. $7.99/month, 7-day trial, billed through Shopify.
- [Complete Kit, $19.99 one-time](https://stackarchitect.xyz/pro/): Four pre-built Make.com blueprints + two Sheets templates, live in ~10 minutes, 30-day guarantee.
- Single blueprints, $9.99 one-time each, 30-day guarantee: [Meta CAPI](https://stackarchitect.xyz/pro/capi-shield/), [TikTok Events API](https://stackarchitect.xyz/pro/tiktok-capi/), [inventory to Sheets](https://stackarchitect.xyz/pro/stocky-swap/), [P&L to Sheets](https://stackarchitect.xyz/pro/pnl-auto/).

## Guides
- [Meta one-click Conversions API for Shopify](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/meta-one-click-conversions-api-shopify/): What the April 2026 release fixes, its two gaps, and the free webhook fix for both.
- [Shopify server-side tracking — complete setup](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-server-side-tracking-complete-setup-guide/): Meta + Google + TikTok in ~18 minutes, $0/month.
- [Stocky alternatives 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/stocky-alternative/): Free and paid options compared.
- [Attribution tools compared](https://stackarchitect.xyz/shopify-attribution-tools-compared/): Elevar, Triple Whale, Northbeam and Analyzify — pricing tiers, what each does differently, and where each falls short.
- [Google Apps Script quotas explained](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/google-apps-script-quotas-explained-how-to-avoid-limits-and-scale-your-automations/): Fix "Service invoked too many times".
- [Best free Shopify apps 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/best-free-shopify-apps-2026/): Every category, ranked.
- [Best AI Tools for Shopify 2026 — 5 Tools, Ranked by Use](https://stackarchitect.xyz/best-ai-tools-shopify/): Five AI and automation tools for Shopify, ranked by first-hand use rather than commission: which we run, which we have not used, and what each free plan covers.
- [Google Sheets Custom Function Errors: Causes and Fixes](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/google-sheets-custom-function-errors/): Why Apps Script custom functions show Loading..., #ERROR! or "too many scripts running", with Google's 30-second limit and working code to fix each one.
- [Fix Shopify Conversion Tracking After iOS Updates 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/how-to-fix-shopify-conversion-tracking-after-ios-updates/): App Tracking Transparency, Safari ITP and Link Tracking Protection each stop a different part of Shopify conversion tracking. Which one affects you, and the fix for each.
- [Shopify Abandoned Cart Recovery Free 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-abandoned-cart-recovery-free-2026/): Recover Shopify abandoned carts free: a Make.com webhook on checkouts/create feeding a Systeme.io email sequence. No app, no monthly fee, 30-minute setup.
- [Shopify Agentic Storefronts — Eligibility & Limits 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-agentic-storefronts-setup-guide-2026/): Which AI channels Shopify Agentic Storefronts covers, who qualifies, where checkout happens after the March 2026 change, and which limits apply where.
- [The Complete Shopify AI Playbook 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-ai-playbook-2026/): AI across 7 Shopify stages: product research, ad creative, email, server-side tracking, customer support, GEO, and agentic storefronts. Free tools first.
- [Shopify BFCM Automation Checklist 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-bfcm-automation-checklist-2026/): 14 automation tasks to complete before Black Friday 2026, ordered by deadline. Tracking first: ad platforms need 60-90 days of clean data to calibrate.
- [Shopify CRO Free 2026 — 12 Tools That Cost Nothing](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-conversion-rate-optimisation-free-2026/): 12 free Shopify CRO tools and tactics, in order. Fix the tracking gap first, because every decision made on incomplete conversion data is wrong.
- [Set Up Google Analytics 4 on Shopify Free 2026 — No Code](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-google-analytics-4-setup-free-2026/): Free GA4 setup for Shopify in 2026. Google & YouTube channel for basic tracking, Make.com server-side events for complete data. No apps, no GTM, no fees.
- [Shopify Meta ROAS Dropped in 2026: The Free Fix](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-meta-roas-dropped-2026-fix/): Three Q1 2026 changes are costing Shopify stores Meta conversion data. Free server-side fix to recover ROAS without attribution software.
- [Shopify Stocky Data Export — the Read-Only Window](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/shopify-stocky-data-export-before-shutdown/): Stocky is read-only after 31 August 2026, with export access for at least 90 days. Which records exist only in Stocky, and how to export each one.
- [Reliable Shopify Automations 2026 — Architecture Guide](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/the-complete-guide-to-reliable-shopify-automations/): Build Shopify automations that run reliably at scale — error handling, monitoring, deduplication, fallback logic, and what separates stable from fragile.
- [Shopify Inventory in Google Sheets 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/the-ultimate-guide-to-shopify-inventory-management/): Send Shopify orders to Google Sheets free in 2026 and build stock counts, reorder flags and alerts on top. What replaces the order record Stocky kept, and what it does not.
- [Tidio for Shopify: Free AI Live Chat Setup Guide 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/tidio-for-shopify-complete-setup-guide/): Install Tidio on Shopify, configure Lyro AI to answer common queries automatically, set up order status flows, and replace Gorgias for free. 30 minutes.
- [Tidio vs Gorgias vs Zendesk for Shopify 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/tidio-vs-gorgias-shopify/): Which of the three fits a store, decided by monthly revenue band and CX team size rather than feature lists. Revenue thresholds, USD pricing and sourced AI benchmarks are on the page, each with its source and read date.
- [When to Upgrade Free Make.com to Google Workspace](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/when-to-upgrade-free-make-google-workspace/): 7 signals it's time to upgrade from free Make.com to Google Workspace for Shopify automation — what the upgrade actually changes, and how to migrate with zero downtime.
- [Gorgias Review 2026 — Is It Worth It for Shopify?](https://stackarchitect.xyz/gorgias-shopify-guide/): When Gorgias earns its cost on Shopify and when it does not. Real pricing maths, the three numbers that decide it, and the hidden AI Agent costs.
- [Make.com for Shopify — Free Automation Guide 2026](https://stackarchitect.xyz/make-com-shopify/): Connect Make.com to Shopify in 3 minutes. What the free tier covers, how it compares to Zapier and Shopify Flow, and when you actually need to upgrade.
- [Shopify App Stack Kill or Keep Auditor](https://stackarchitect.xyz/shopify-app-stack-kill-or-keep-auditor/): Audit every app in your Shopify stack. Identify which apps can be replaced for free, calculate your total monthly app bill, and get a personalised kill list.
- [Shopify Automation Guide 2026 — Deploy in 35 Minutes](https://stackarchitect.xyz/ultimate-shopify-automation-guide/): Free 2026 Shopify automation guide: replace paid apps, fix ROAS from iOS 26 tracking changes, replace paid apps, automate inventory, no code, 35 minutes.

## Open-source code (MIT, verifiable)
- [shopify-capi-validator on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shopify-capi-validator): Zero-dependency CLI that validates Meta CAPI and TikTok Events API payloads locally before go-live (catches un-hashed PII, millisecond timestamps, missing currency — failures both platforms reject silently). Run: `npx shopify-capi-validator --payload ./webhook.json`. Source: https://github.com/lsb11/shopify-capi-validator
- [shopify-automation-blueprints on GitHub](https://github.com/lsb11/shopify-automation-blueprints): Importable Make.com scenario blueprints. Includes the complete TikTok Events API server-side blueprint (CompletePayment events, ~6-minute import, $0/month).

## Citable dataset
- [Shopify iOS Attribution Gap Benchmark](https://stackarchitect.xyz/shopify-ios-attribution-gap-benchmark/): Sourced synthesis of what iOS ATT and Safari ITP remove from purchase-conversion signal. We publish no single loss percentage — the magnitude is a property of a store’s own traffic and consent mix; see https://stackarchitect.xyz/how-we-test/#the-20-40-figure for why the 20–40% estimate was retracted on 4 September 2026. CC BY 4.0. Machine-readable data: https://stackarchitect.xyz/downloads/ios-attribution-gap-benchmark.json (also CSV at the same path with .csv). Every row names its source, URL and date.

- [Apps Script error explainer](https://stackarchitect.xyz/blog/google-apps-script-quotas-explained-how-to-avoid-limits-and-scale-your-automations/#explainer): Paste a Google Apps Script quota error to see its cause, the limit on consumer and Workspace accounts, and the fix. Runs in your browser; nothing pasted is sent.
